input.answer:
I can't tell you whether to buy or keep renting. That depends on your personal finances, goals, and how long you plan to stay, and it's a personal financial decision, which is outside what I can advise on. I haven't pulled any figures for this answer.

If you want to compare the costs yourself, Statistics Canada publishes Toronto-area rent data in table 46-10-0092 (asking and paid rents by unit type and bedrooms, quarterly). For house prices, look at table 18-10-0205 (new housing price index, monthly, which includes Toronto-area geographies). Note that the new housing price index measures new homes only, so it doesn't capture resale prices. For personal guidance, a licensed financial advisor or mortgage professional can review your situation.
